attention4.ptxt: Applying a shock to the catalytic converter without GPF may cause damage to the inside the catalyst.
Handle the catalytic converter without GPF carefully not to drop it or hit it against something.

s1.ptxt: Disconnect negative (–) cable at battery.
Drain coolant.
Remove engine cover.
Release HO2S-1 and HO2S-2 wire harness from clamps (1).
Disconnect HO2S-1 (1) and HO2S-2 (2) connectors and then detach them from the bracket.
Remove HO2S-1 and HO2S-2, if necessary.
Remove turbocharger water inlet hose (3) and turbocharger water outlet hose (4).
Remove catalytic converter cover (1).
Remove catalytic converter stiffener (1).
Remove engine undercover.
Remove exhaust pipe nuts (1) from exhaust pipe.
Remove exhaust pipe stiffener bolts (2) from oil pan.
Remove catalytic converter without GPF (1) and its gasket from turbocharger.

topic.title: Installation
topic.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: If the turbocharger is to be reused, check the threaded holes in the flange and the mating surface for rust which may cause loosening of the bolts and nuts.
If rusted, remove the rust by grinding the surface and tapping the threaded holes.
Torx® type stud bolt head could be damaged when tightening.
Carefully tighten the stud bolt.
Use new gaskets.
Use new bolts, stud bolts and nuts.
Tighten new stud bolt until incomplete thread reaches.
Install catalytic converter without GPF and its stiffener as follows.
Install catalytic converter without GPF (1) and its stiffener (2), and tighten new catalytic converter nuts (3) and stiffener nut (4) by hand.
Tighten catalytic converter nuts and stiffener nut with wrench until they are seated and then loosen the all nuts 90°.
Tighten stiffener bolt (5) with wrench until it is seated.
Tighten new catalytic converter bolts (6) and nuts to specified torque.
Tighten stiffener bolt securely.
Tighten stiffener nut to specified torque.
Tighten exhaust pipe nuts (1) to specified torque.
Tighten exhaust pipe stiffener bolts (2) securely.
Install HO2S-1 and HO2S-2 if removed.
Clamp HO2S-1 and HO2S-2 lead wire.
Refill cooling system with coolant.
Check cooling system for leakage.
Run engine and check for exhaust gas leakage.

attention4.ptxt: Applying a shock to the catalytic converter with GPF may cause damage to the inside the catalyst.
Handle the catalytic converter with GPF carefully not to drop it or hit it against something.

s1.ptxt: Disconnect negative (–) cable at battery.
Drain coolant.
Remove engine cover.
Release A/F sensor and HO2S-2 wire harness from clamps (1).
Disconnect A/F sensor (1) and HO2S-2 (2) connectors and then detach them from the bracket.
Remove A/F sensor from catalytic converter with GPF.
Remove HO2S-2 from catalytic converter with GPF, if necessary.
Remove turbocharger water inlet hose (3) and turbocharger water outlet hose (4).
Remove GPF pressure sensor hose No.1 (1) and GPF pressure sensor hose No.2 (2).
Remove catalytic converter cover (1).
Remove engine undercover.
Remove catalytic converter stiffener (1).
Remove exhaust No.1 pipe nuts (1) from exhaust No.1 pipe.
Remove exhaust No.1 pipe stiffener bolts (2) from oil pan.
Remove catalytic converter with GPF (1) and its gasket from turbocharger.

topic.title: Installation
topic.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: If the turbocharger is to be reused, check the threaded holes in the flange and the mating surface for rust which may cause loosening of the bolts and nuts.
If rusted, remove the rust by grinding the surface and tapping the threaded holes.
Torx® type stud bolt head could be damaged when tightening.
Carefully tighten the stud bolt.
Use new gaskets.
Use new bolts, stud bolts and nuts.
Tighten new stud bolt until incomplete thread reaches.
Install catalytic converter with GPF and its stiffener as follows.
Install catalytic converter with GPF (1) to turbocharger and tighten catalytic converter new nuts (3) by hand.
Install catalytic converter stiffener (4) and tighten stiffener bolt (5) and nut (6) by hand.
Tighten catalytic converter nuts, stiffener bolt and nut in this order with wrench until they are seated.
Loosen catalytic converter nuts, stiffener bolt and nut 90°.
Tighten new catalytic converter bolts (2) and nuts to specified torque.
Tighten catalytic converter stiffener bolt and nut to specified torque.
Tighten exhaust pipe nuts (1) to specified torque.
Tighten exhaust pipe stiffener bolts (2) securely.
Fix A/F sensor and HO2S-2 harness with clamps (1) as shown in figure.
Set clamp (2) just on positioning tapes (3) on the harnesses. Deviation from the center of the tapes is not allowed.
Install HO2S-2, if removed.
Refill cooling system with coolant.
Check cooling system for leakage.
Run engine and check for exhaust gas leakage.
After replacing catalytic converter with GPF with new one, perform the following procedure.
When ignition is “OFF”, connect SUZUKI scan tool to DLC.
Set ignition “ON”.
Execute “Initialize GPF data” in “Utility” menu following instructions displayed on SUZUKI scan tool.
When ignition is “OFF”, disconnect SUZUKI scan tool from DLC.
